summary: Phase 20 'live 3D during the walk' tested in the browser. All 6 requested checks essentially pass: Watch live link appears on the client page and routes to /live/{id}; the /live page renders the 3D scene, picture, caption, last checkpoint, counts, model line, legend and Free look toggle; after end the picture clears to 'No live picture right now.', live-connection reads 'Run ended' and the Review link ('Run ended. Open the review') appears and points at /review/{id}; the teach-live-3d panel renders Scene3D with growing points, trail, checkpoint markers and the live picture while counters + Finish/Cancel remain. Backend behaviour (204 live-frame post-end, 404 for replay attempts and unknown ids) confirmed. /replay/{id} and /live/{unknown} regression paths still render correctly.

issues: The legend block on /live/{id} is rendered but has no data-testid='live-legend' hook (the task mentioned 'legend' without a specific testid, so this is just an FYI if a future test wants to assert it).

live_page_during_run.note_about_Live_label: The sim is deliberately short and frames stop before the attempt ends (see request note: 'Vision unavailable, please pause.'), so the UI usually transitions straight from the brief live window to 'Run ended' within the 1s poll. During the first visit I observed 'Not connected' / 'Run ended' because frames had just stopped; the picture was still visible from the newest in-memory frame. This matches the backend state (live:false near end) and is not a UI bug.

teach_live_3d.scene_aria-label_sample: Live 3D map while walking: 24,285 points, 11.1 metres walked, 2 checkpoints proposed. The counters below give the same information.
teach_live_3d.cleanup_run: python3 teach_walk_sim.py cleanup -> teach sessions deleted: 1, photos now unservable 404

regression./replay/{id}: Renders Demo replay with Scene3D, Replaying on v1 badge, Last checkpoint, Cues spoken, Frame 12 of 12 · Replay finished, 'See the practitioner review of this replay' link.

critical_code_review_comments: live-free-look-toggle is a native <input type=checkbox>; its toggled state is tracked via the `checked` property, not aria-pressed. If a future test wants to assert it, use the DOM `checked` or the visible label.

The scene aria-label with growing point count lives on the outer div [data-testid='teach-live-scene'] (role=group), not on the <canvas>. If the main agent wants it on the canvas too, that would make the assertion more intuitive from the task description, but the current approach is accessibility-friendly and the request only says 'the canvas aria-label point count grows over time' which can be read either way.
seed_data_creation: Ran teach_walk_sim.py walk three times (crashed on 2nd and 3rd WS mid-walk due to timing; backend session survived) and then teach_walk_sim.py cleanup which removed the teach route and session cleanly. Also started sim_live_run.py demo three times for /live testing - leaves demo attempts on client 0a8239a5-...; main agent will run python3 /app/tests/sim_live_run.py cleanup. One replay attempt 16297540-cccd-48ad-84f6-074c4bd9d089 was created on the demo route per the request (not deleted; the request says 'just report the id').
context_for_next_testing_agent: The sim_live_run.py sim is deliberately short (even STEP_S=6 completes in ~15s because the demo recording only has a dozen frames and frames stop before 'end'); so when you open /live/{id} manually you will almost always see 'Not connected' or 'Run ended' rather than the 'Live' banner. To observe 'Live' you must drive a longer live stream or inspect GET /api/attempts/{id}/live mid-run. Legend on /live/{id} is rendered but has no data-testid; use text selectors like 'Spoken cue (circle)'. Teach live scene aria-label lives on the outer div [data-testid='teach-live-scene'] (role=group), not on the canvas. Picture img src is a URL like /api/teach/{id}/live-frame?t=... (len ~95 chars), not a data URI.
